title: Kristen Wiig sells 1965 Pasadena modernist home for $4.675 million, takes $825,000 loss
summary_full: ‘Wonder Woman 1984’ actress Kristen Wiig has sold her 1965 Midcentury Modern home in Pasadena, California, for $4.675 million, taking an $825,000 loss. The actress had initially listed the architectural property for $6.25 million before making multiple price cuts.
